title: Illness journal
start_desc: Track temperature, medicines given and symptoms in one place. Your partner can see it and add entries too.
chart_empty: The chart appears once there are at least 2 readings
no_entries: No entries yet. Add one with the buttons above.
temp_hint: Slide, or fine-tune with the buttons
remind_desc: You'll be reminded on this phone, and your partner gets notified too
no_dose_calc: Anacan does not calculate doses. Enter the dose and interval only as your doctor or the medicine leaflet says.
too_early: The last {med} was given {ago} ago, and the interval is {h} hours. Please wait unless your doctor said otherwise.
emergency: 38.0 °C or higher in a baby under 3 months
Difficulty breathing, lips or skin turning blue
A rash that doesn't fade when pressed with a glass
Hard to wake, very floppy, or having a seizure
No wet diaper for more than 8 hours, dry mouth
The soft spot (fontanelle) is sunken or bulging
doctor: Temperature doesn't come down even after medicine
39 °C or higher in a baby aged 3–6 months
alert_infant: {temp} °C in a {months}-month-old baby — see a doctor right away.
alert_high: Temperature is {temp} °C. See a doctor, and call {number} if there are changes in breathing or alertness.
alert_long: Fever for more than 3 days — have a doctor check your baby today.
alert_breathing: You logged trouble breathing — call {number} right away.
healed_desc: Close the episode — it stays in your history
healed_toast: We were going to say get well soon… but they already are! 💚
delete_confirm: Delete this episode with all its entries?
partner_start_msg: 🤒 An illness journal was opened for {child}: {kind}. Let's track temperature and medicines together.
notif_body: The interval your doctor gave for {child} is up.
error: Couldn't save. Check your internet and try again.
disclaimer: This journal does not replace medical advice.
premium_pdf: The PDF summary is a Premium feature
